name: North Carolina

regulator.name: North Carolina Secretary of State, Athlete Agent Registration

law.name: Uniform Athlete Agents Act, amended for NIL in 2025 (G.S. 78C-85 and following)

covers_nil_agents: Yes. Since July 1, 2025, NIL agency contracts are agency contracts and need their own NIL warning (G.S. 78C-86, 78C-94).
summary: Register with the Secretary of State. $200, renewed every year.
contract_warning: Warning to student-athlete. Entering into an NIL contract that conflicts with state law or your institution's policies may have negative consequences, such as loss of athletic eligibility. You may cancel this NIL agency contract within 14 days after signing it.

steps.text: Fill out the Initial Application for Registration

steps.detail: Check, money order or cashier's check to the NC Department of the Secretary of State.

steps.text: Register with each school's compliance office, if it asks
steps.detail: Most schools have their own agent sign-up.

steps.text: Some North Carolina lawyers don't need to register
steps.detail: A lawyer licensed and living in NC can skip registering if they don't advertise for athletes and have no more than 2 athlete clients.

steps.text: If an athlete contacts you first, apply within 7 days
steps.detail: You can act as their agent before you're registered, but you can't sign a contract until you are.

steps.text: Use a written contract with all required items
steps.detail: Your pay and how it's figured, plus any other pay you get for the deal. Anyone not on your application who gets paid, expenses the athlete pays back, your services, how long it lasts and the date signed.

steps.text: For a pro sports contract, put the warning to student-athlete box next to the athlete's signature
steps.detail: Bold capital letters, word for word from G.S. 78C-94(c). It is different from the NIL warning.

steps.text: Give the athlete a copy when they sign
For a pro sports contract, notify the athletic director within 72 hours of signing
steps.detail: Do it in writing, or before the athlete's next scheduled game if that comes first. NC law doesn't require this notice for NIL contracts.

steps.text: Let the athlete cancel within 14 days if they want
steps.detail: They cancel by telling you in writing. They owe you nothing and keep anything you gave them. This right can't be waived.

steps.text: Date the contract the day it's signed
steps.detail: Federal law (SPARTA) bans pre-dating or post-dating it.

steps.text: For an NIL contract, put the NIL warning box next to the athlete's signature
steps.detail: Bold capital letters. Use the exact words from G.S. 78C-94(c1).
Names and addresses, every contract and your recruiting costs. The state can inspect them during business hours.

steps.text: Don't sign an NIL client at a school you worked for in the last 2 years
steps.detail: This covers jobs and contracts with the school. If a client later enrolls there, the NIL contract is void.

steps.text: Never give false info or gifts to get an athlete to sign
steps.detail: Don't give anything of value before they sign, or to anyone but the athlete or another registered agent. This is a Class I felony.
Your registration lasts 1 year (G.S. 78C-90). If it lapses you can't act as an agent until the renewal is approved.

watch_list.item: Federal Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (S.4668)
watch_list.status: Passed the Senate on Sept 28, 2026. The House is out until Nov 9 and leaders say it won't pass as-is. It dies if not enacted by Jan 3, 2027.
watch_list.impact: It would require every NIL agent to register in a state, cap agent fees at 5% of an endorsement deal and limit contracts to the athlete's eligibility.

review_notes: Pro sports contracts need a different warning, in G.S. 78C-94(c). Only the NIL warning is stored in contract_warning.

The list of prohibited acts in G.S. 78C-98(b) still says agents must warn athletes that signing makes them ineligible. It is unclear how that applies to NIL-only contracts. Confirm with the Secretary of State.
The application steps don't say where to send the form. Confirm the mailing address at https://sosnc.gov/divisions/athlete_agents/registration_requirements.
